plugin.note: Chaos druids have defence level 12 and zero defensive bonuses, so any style kills them quickly; bring cheap Wilderness-appropriate gear. Krystilia only counts the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness) spawns.

requirements: Kills must be made in the Wilderness to count for the Krystilia assignment.
No Slayer level or quest requirement.
mechanics: Chaos druids (npc 520) are combat level 13 with 20 Hitpoints and grant 20 Slayer XP.
They attack with crush melee and cast a weaken/bind spell; max hit is low.
They have defence level 12 and zero defensive bonuses.
They drop herbs from the herb table (guam to snapdragon), making the task profitable.

methods.label: Any melee
methods.summary: Kill the 11 Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness) chaos druids with any melee weapon.
steps: Enter the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon.
Kill the chaos druids with any weapon (they have no defensive bonuses).
Pick up and bank the herb drops between trips.
notes: Bring only cheap gear; this is a low-level Wilderness spot with PKer risk.

methods.label: Ranged or magic
methods.summary: Attack from range with ranged or magic to keep distance in the Wilderness.
recommendedFor: players who want to avoid the druids' melee/spell
steps: Enter the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon.
Attack the chaos druids with ranged or magic (all their defences are 0).
Bank the herb drops between trips.
notes: Their weaken/bind spell has a short reach; ranging avoids their melee entirely.

styleOptions.label: Any melee
styleOptions.summary: Zero defensive bonuses mean any style works; melee is simplest.
